item: A9: C2 confirmation without the epicentral zone of the 2025-12-06 M6.8
radius_rule: 95 % quantile of epicentral distances of sequence events >= Mc, day 2 to 2025-12-31, rounded up to 5 km (51.44 km -> 55 km)
reduced_baseline_rule: relative to the frozen baseline: log mu_ref + mean(ly_red) - mean(ly_full); sigma_y * sd(ly_red) / sd(ly_full); ly = yearly log mu 2016-2025 (zone_check.yearly_log_mu) on the frozen 2016-2025 snapshot
confirmation_text: a C2 rejection at a look counts as confirmed only if the reduced statistic (glacier region outside the zone, reduced baseline, control unchanged) has a one-sided p below the alpha of that look (0.01 / 0.04)
